name: SF LGBT Center
description: Free employment services, financial counseling, youth programs, and community resources
fullDescription: The San Francisco LGBT Center is a cornerstone of the LGBTQ+ community, offering employment services, free financial counseling, small business help, youth services, and community programs at 1800 Market Street.
whatTheyOffer:
- Employment services, including the Trans Employment Program (career coaching, job referrals, resume help)
- Free financial counseling and first-time homebuyer and rental services
- Small business consulting and entrepreneur workshops
- Youth services (drop-in navigation, mental health, housing programs)
- Information and referral, arts and culture, and volunteer programs
- Free legal clinics with partner organizations
- Computer lab and meeting space for LGBTQ+ organizations
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the SF LGBT Center in person or online
2. Check program eligibility requirements
3. Register for services or programs
4. Some services require appointments
5. Call 415-865-5555 with questions
